resolution: The new trace showed the owner ring was polluted by diagnostic command self-noise: the spike report kept naming PlayRoute Text nodes created by gv_churntrace command output and later removal of older gv_perflog transcript text, while the terminal reports themselves are not rendered UI. I added a suppressTranscript command-result flag so diagnostic commands can still return script-visible output without drawing input/output lines in the live console overlay, wired the console session to remove suppressed submissions from its visible transcript, and marked gv_perflog plus gv_churntrace as suppressed. This prevents the diagnostic arming commands from becoming React Text nodes or later transcript-ring removals in the measured scene, while preserving terminal spike reports and verify-script output. Built with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int and ./tools/rjit game verify green.
